info.title: FeedAstrolabe API
info.description: Bearer API key required. Cloudflare deployments additionally require Access service authentication at the edge. Dates are UTC. Article cursors use ID order.

BearerKey.description: Scoped expiring API key issued in /settings

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Use only one of before_id/after_id; records ordered by ID (revision numbers for history). Existing tag/workspace IDs required.

before_id.name: before_id
before_id.description: Use only one of before_id/after_id; records ordered by ID (revision numbers for history). Existing tag/workspace IDs required.

after_id.name: after_id
after_id.description: Use only one of before_id/after_id; records ordered by ID (revision numbers for history). Existing tag/workspace IDs required.

tag.name: tag
tag.description: Use only one of before_id/after_id; records ordered by ID (revision numbers for history). Existing tag/workspace IDs required.

workspace.name: workspace
workspace.description: Use only one of before_id/after_id; records ordered by ID (revision numbers for history). Existing tag/workspace IDs required.

patch.description: Common fields: folder, enabled, poll_interval. URL: RSS/page only. selector/settle_ms/retention_days: page only. Source type and SNS identity are immutable. URL edits preserve history; page target changes reset baseline. No fetch during edits.
